sources.title: Official .pen format and TypeScript schema
sources.claim: Live public reference: versioned document/children tree, unique entity IDs without slash, absolute coordinates, literal properties, frames, text, components and complex constructs. Documentation is a reference only; no vendor schema implementation was copied.

sources.title: Official .pen file workflow
sources.claim: Official guidance prefers app/CLI/MCP edits, preserves originals and uses Git history; this workbench exports independent candidates rather than claiming official validation.

sources.title: Official pen.dev CLI
sources.claim: Existing headless editor engine, direct operations, MCP tools and image exports form the baseline. This app does not reproduce the proprietary engine or its tool grammar.
